scope: Phase22: preserve the existing TTS aggregator and recognize punctuation carried inside SDK text chunks; run fixed user-experience acceptance gates. Overall goal NOT achieved.

finish_criteria.requirement: Existing full/half/PTT speaking-profile, button, cancellation and reply regressions pass; real 15-case cascade passes.
Resolve the 3 conditional-pause cases and 3 default overlapping-intent counterexamples. They may not remain xfailed for completion. Keep existing short-answer and complete-turn latency ceilings.
The existing date/cost audio fixtures both cancel correctly, produce a single new reply and reach new-TTS-correlated RTC audio within 2500 ms from actual input speech end.

external_acceptance: Authenticated production Agent RPC, physical AEC and long device output remain separately tracked, not claimed tested by direct_llm virtual RTC.

production_change.cause: LiveKit filter_markdown can emit punctuation at the start of a subsequent chunk. Checking only the last character misses an available sentence, sometimes until EOF or the maximum length.
production_change.fix: Inspect the existing whole buffer for hard punctuation and the last soft boundary position. Retain whole-buffer batching and existing first-segment/soft minimum/hard maximum/idle/explicit flush settings. No second tokenizer, timer, model, cache or SDK edit.
production_change.qualification: The outgoing batch may include an available suffix after the punctuation, as with existing whole-buffer behavior; this is not a new exact sentence tokenizer.
